title: EmailSubmissionFilterCondition placed in submission.rs, referenced from query.rs
description: EmailSubmissionFilterCondition lives in submission.rs (line 224) but EmailSubmissionFilter = Filter<EmailSubmissionFilterCondition> is defined in query.rs (line 20) via a cross-module reference. A future contributor adding a comparator for EmailSubmission/query would look in query.rs, find the type alias but not the condition, then hunt in submission.rs. Suggested rewrite: move EmailSubmissionFilterCondition to query.rs alongside EmailFilterCondition, or move both filter conditions to submission.rs and email.rs respectively with the type aliases in query.rs pointing into them — the current split (condition in one module, alias in another) is the awkward middle ground.
